t: Kill 6 Dusty Wolves and report back to Pip the Rowdy.

You've only just recently come to the Inn, haven't you? You look like it, too. I don't know about you, but I'm ready for a beer! I've just come back from beyond the Cordon! Phew!
You better be careful out there because the mafia's goblins are at it again! They've started fattening up and taming the wolves! It's amazing how vicious those animals have become! Smart, cleaver, and loyal like dogs but dangerous like tigers!
It's tough for the Prospectors out there, very tough. The mafia is really trying to squeeze us out. I only managed to collect two artifacts, and even then I only just barely managed to escape... Something really needs to be done about it before they completely strangle us...
Lets declare a war on the wolves! If we kill all the animals, the mafia won't have anything to train to attack us!
I'll have nightmares of those teeth at my throat for nights. Ugh!
I can tell that the wolves are howling less during the nights. It's great! I'm already starting to recover from what I saw on my trip past the Cordon.

Argh! You're all the same! How many times do I have to say that I know nothing about it? Yes, Boko belonged to my clan! Yes, he became fabulously rich and bought a whole allod, but I have no idea where he got the money! I don't want to hear anything about him!
That Boko disgraced my clan! He was nothing but a mean bastard! I'm sure that whatever he did to get that money, it wasn't legal. I would advise you not to follow in his footsteps.
h: Ask them about the Wish Maker

t: What do you want? Speak quickly, I'm busy!
Kill 6 Goblin Soldiers and report back to the Tussling Family.

Oh well, I suppose help will always come in useful for something.
We have already broken through the mafia's defenses and taken the bridge – it's our first success in several months! But we can't relax just yet - the goblins are trying to take the bridge back! Crossing to the other side of the Cordon is still very dangerous... We'll need to kill all the goblins in the vicinity before we can even attempt it.
Hurry it up! We need to clear the approaches to the bridge.
Excellent! Now let's consider how to best defend our newly acquired bridge.
Kill 6 Steppe Vultures to the south of Giant's Table. Report back to the Tussling Family.

Who would have guessed that goblins would be our sneakiest opponents. They haven't only tamed the wolves but the vultures too!
Prospectors are complaining that the birds are constantly watching them and trying to enter their caves. They say that as soon as one of them gets in, they call the goblins to rush in with their screams.
The vultures are probably nesting in the northern hills. So, how about we go up there for some hunting? If they have enough brains to understand how to serve the goblins, perhaps they'll have enough to understand that it's time to stop!
There are stories about a vulture leader. They say his claws are like Orcish daggers and his beak is as strong as stone. Be careful out there!
Now the Prospectors will be able to collect more artifacts, the Traders are going to make higher profits, and that means our pay will go up too!
Vissarion Arhivin is untrustworthy. Give the report to Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

Let's see what we've got here... Tep was basing his research into immortality on old June magic. There's your link between the two nations. The poor June people died from the Curse, which is somehow connected to our Astral demons. Well, what if they are our Curse?... I don't even want to think about that.
Then we have this ancient mysterious creature – a Wormface... Too bad someone had to go and kill it. Relax - I can't blame you for it - for you, it was just another monster. But we Historians are always sad to see the demise of something ancient, something that could have held the key to so many mysteries...
Anyway, let's move on from the sad stuff. I have depicted the results of both my research and that of Gerodot and his team, in my report entitled "The June and Zem - Analysis of Interconnections." I suppose this document merits the attention of Zayan himself. But where do we find him? Hmm... Zayan is an odd personality, but he is also one of the oldest of the Great Mages. Perhaps the oldest, now that Skrakan is dead. As you can imagine, he doesn't report to us on where he goes and when.
If anybody knows his location it's Vissarion Arhivin, chairman of our expedition to the Holy Land. Try asking him, if you can find him. Though to be honest with you, I've never really been a fan of Vissarion. It's like you never really know what he's thinking...

It's good that you're here. We need to talk about something important. Namely, the Historians.
My sources tell me that Bertille de Pluie has given you a document that chronicles all the research the Historians have conducted in the Holy Land. Surprised that I know? Well, don't be. You're dealing with the City Council, after all.
Kill Abordazh the Merciless and report back to Thibault de Desirae.

We have been observing the pirates since they have landed on the Plateau and we have cause to be alarmed! Among them is Abordazh the Merciless! This is a dangerous and terrible enemy. His name cannot even be uttered without a shudder. He has captured dozens of ships and enslaved hundreds of souls.
Though, I don't know what he intends to do in the Holy Land. Maybe he's looking for a place for new base. Or maybe he was brought here by stories about the artifacts... Who knows...
But there is one thing that I am certain of! He must be put down! You can do it! Not alone, of course, but you can still do it!
You'll need a good team. If you can assemble one and kill the Admiral, it will be a great feat. One that will be spoken of for years to come!
They say that the Astral Blade, their so-called "warship," paints a skull on the side of their ship for every ship that they capture. They claim to have run out of room...
That's good news! I'm sure that traveling the Astral will be much safer now, and it's all thanks to you!
Participate in killing Skarskul and report back to Gorislav Gipitsky in the Prospectors' Inn.

We've been waiting around for a long time for someone like you to come along. We need a group of brave and bold champions to stand up to the real menace around here.
Skarskul is a macabre skeleton that inhabit the Spectral Gorge. What a cursed being! He's sent many Prospectors to Purgatory. It's time to wipe this beast from the earth. And you look like just the type to do it. Collect a group reliable friends and destroy the monster!
Because of this Skarskul, few Prospectors dare to enter the Gorge... but there are so many artifacts to be found!
Cheers! You are a real hero to the Prospectors. We all thank you.
Vissarion Arhivin is untrustworthy. Give the report to Marianne de Ardeur in Novograd.

Let's see what we've got here... Tep was basing his research into immortality on old June magic. There's your link between the two nations. The poor June people died from the Curse, which is somehow connected to our Astral demons. Well, what if they are our Curse?... I don't even want to think about that.
Then we have this ancient mysterious creature – a Wormface... Too bad someone had to go and kill it. Relax - I can't blame you for it - for you, it was just another monster. But we Historians are always sad to see the demise of something ancient, something that could have held the key to so many mysteries...
Anyway, let's move on from the sad stuff. I have depicted the results of both my research and that of Gerodot and his team, in my report entitled "The June and Zem - Analysis of Interconnections." I suppose this document merits the attention of Zayan himself. But where do we find him? Hmm... Zayan is an odd personality, but he is also one of the oldest of the Great Mages. Perhaps the oldest, now that Skrakan is dead. As you can imagine, he doesn't report to us on where he goes and when.
If anybody knows his location it's Vissarion Arhivin, chairman of our expedition to the Holy Land. Try asking him, if you can find him. Though to be honest with you, I've never really been a fan of Vissarion. It's like you never really know what he's thinking...
It's wonderful to see you again, child.

I was just thinking about you the other day.
The Church of Light has received knowledge that you are in possession of Bertille de Pluie's report - a document that contains all the data gathered by the Historians over the course of their work in the Holy Land. Hey, don't be mad! The loyal children of the Church of Light are everywhere, and there's nothing dishonorable in informing me about things that concern the Church's interests. And the Historians are currently on top of that list...
Talk to Gorislav Gipitsky at the tavern on Coba Plateau.
This letter, signed by the same mysterious Director who set up the search for the Revelation on Gipat, invites you to visit the tavern on Coba Plateau and talk to Gorislav Gipitsky.

I haven't seen you in ages!
What are you doing here?
What? What letter? I can't write at all, you know...
Ask other prospectors about the "Wish Granter" and then return to Yaver Qar.

Hello there.
Are you a prospector, too? Yeah, yeah. Just like everyone else here visiting the Inn... You dream about finding artifacts, getting rich and retiring, right? Ha-ha.
It's all rubbish. There is only one valuable Darkness artifact to be hunting for. It is worth more than anything on all of Sarnaut!
Tell me, have you heard of the "Wish Granter?" No? Then I won't tell you anything yet... But if you want to learn more about it, talk to other prospectors.
Everything they tell you will be false, but I'd like to see what sort of crazy stories are going around these days.
Go on, ask them. Then come back to me when you're done.
So, What did those fools tell you?

Ha-ha! You see, everyone has their own version of what the “Wish Granter" is.
But only I know what the truth about it is.
Sprinkle the 3 Tep Tombs on Coba Plateau with holy water, defeat the guardians, and interact with the Tomb. Report back to prospector Yaver Qar.

You know, I have devoted most of my second life to studying Tep's heritage. So, I knew a bit about his methods...
There are three tombs in Coba Plateau that are of great interest to me. If we presume that the basic story is true, then they can be the clue to this riddle. They can be found to the north, east, and south of the Inn.
Nobody knows what they are for, but I have an idea. And this is where you come in. I want you to find these three tombs and sprinkle them with holy water. Yeah, yeah... "Light will cleanse it! Blah, blah, blah..." Do you think that Light can stand up to the power of Tep?
That's the million gold question, isn't it?! Let's see if the Light really can stand up to Tep's almighty power.
What were you able to find out?

Oh, you don't say...
It seems that the Light really can stand up to Tep's power... But more importantly, Tep's power was fueled by 3 imprisoned sparks? No, this can't be. There has to be more to this...
Kill 6 Cobian Tigers to release the spark imprisoned in the stele. Once you complete the task, find out whether it worked.

Ah! Who's there?! Is it you, Great Master?
Please, oh Great Tensess, do not turn away from me!
Help me!
Tep will release my Spark for six Sparks of wild beasts. Tigers! He needs tigers!
Great Tensess! Show mercy, I beg of you... I will serve you for eternity! For eternity! Eternity...!
Oh, thank you! Thank you for having mercy on this wayward sheep!
Kill 6 Red Band Bandits to release the spark imprisoned in the stele. Once you complete the task, find out whether it worked.

Ah! Who's there?! Is it you, Great Master?
Ah-ha! It's a shadow! You're back to talk in whispers about secular life! Go away. I'm okay here! I'm not going anywhere! Even if you kill those two-legged bandit creatures! I still won't leave! I serve the Master! I am nobody now!
No! I told you I won't leave! I serve the Master!

I am nobody... Hah! I am nobody!
I am just a shadow in the night!
I am forever dead... Thank Tep!
h: Listen to what the Spirit has to say

t: You can see outlines of a ghostly figure on the stone... This spirit, trapped by Tep's magis, seems to be trying to tell you something.
Kill 6 Fierce Ogres to release the spark imprisoned in the stele. Once you complete the task, find out whether it worked.

Can anybody hear me?
Damnation! Hey! I'm here!
You need to kill six Fierce Ogres to free me! Hey!
My goodness! Tep! You bastard! It's not that hard! They're right there!
Just do it!
Oh! You're back! Does that mean you've done it?
Oh! What a relief! Thank you!
Kill 6 Windscales in Spectral Gorge to summon the Great Dragon. Defeat the Great Dragon and report back to Yaver Qar.

Ah, my old friend!
Do you wish to work for Tep again?
My, how eager you are now that you've tasted the power of the Master. Very well, Master needs the souls of the great dragon from the Spectral Gorge.
What's that? You've never seen a dragon in Coba Plateau? This great dragon only appears when the souls of ten windscales have been taken!
Even with your newfound power, you will not be able to defeat him alone. So, I hope you still have some friends left. Tep's gratitude will be your reward
If you wish to remain alive, it would be best to keep your mouth shut about my connection to the Master.
Tep and I thank you. You have been a most enthusiastic errand boy.
Party with 3 other players and persuade them to break the ancient tablets by the sacrificial pedestal in the Kobold caves.

Your investigation confirms all my theories about the "Wish Granter." And, if you'd like, I can share them all with you.

My first theory is that the artifact really does exist! That one is easy. The second one is that to use its power, one must sacrifice three other creatures. Do you think you're up for this?

Good. Go to the kobold caves. It is there where you will find an ancient pedestal for sacrifices. We have to do it exactly like how it was done before. You'll need to find three followers that will agree to break these three ancient tablets.

They absolutely must be in your group! No stragglers, got it? And they can't know what you're about to do. They must be pure.

If you think you're up to this heinous task, then go, gather your sacrifices!

Ha-ha-ha! Your willingness to trust strangers and your greed has made it easy for my lord to receive three new sources of power. And you, you're a murderer.
But don't fret, here's the reward I promised you. I hope it's worth it.
Kill 6 Cave Kobolds to cleanse yourself of Tep's curse. Report back to Yaver Qar.

Ah-ha! A victim of someone's wish!
Hah! May I ask how it happened? Was it willingly or did someone cheat you?
But that's not important. All that matters is that you are here and now you can join Tep's curious little game.
The Master needs sparks. The more, the better. That's why you're here, though you're not looking so well...
Do you want to lift the curse?
Then kill six kobolds. They're an eyesore anyway.

I recommend that you tell no one of what has happened here today.
Otherwise... Well, we'll just say that even all the kobold sparks in the world won't put a dent in the curse Tep will place upon you!
You know the best part of this Wish Granter scam? People just keep coming back! You silly mortals and your greed!
Report to Colonel Steeler of the Righteous at the Imperial Camp on Coba Plateau.

This situation is getting worse by the minute!
The new Holy cloaks strangle their owners and the blades wound them. The power of the artifacts is growing and they are becoming more and more expensive. All adventurers, pirates, and vagabonds are flooding the Plateau. The Holy Land is in uproar! The world has gone mad! Everyone is trying to make their share of the gold and no one cares that the Light is leaving and darkness is taking its place.
So there you are!
Right now, the events that are unfolding in Coba Plateau are directly influencing which side – us or the League - is going to have the advantage in war. So get there as fast as you can!
The Imperial Regiment on the Plateau is led by Steeler the Righteous. He is the smartest Orc I have ever met. You can find our camp in the south. It's called Russet Station. Don't ask me what that means, it's probably some local dialect.
I hope you can find the camp and establish some common ground with Steeler.

Nomarkh Userkaf... Hmm, I don't know anyone called that, but it doesn't matter. I will be happy to accept any help.
I'll bring you up to date.
This issue of "Truth" has published Yasker's latest speech. His policy is – "Our goal is to take Coba Plateau by forcing out the League!"
So let's do that.
Speak with Semer Kiya at the Russet Station.

Now listen to me carefully. While you were running all over Eljune, we've been stuck here. We haven't moved forward at all. We still haven't been able to penetrate the magical field and go inside the Temple.
Every day some Arisen scientist says that they're about to break through the magical field, but I don't believe their promises anymore. And by the way, even a fool knows that whoever gets inside the Temple to save Tensess will win the war!
That's why I'm asking you to go to Coba Plateau immediately. There's a struggle there for the dark artifacts. The City Council has established a special sub-council that is responsible for those artifacts. This sub-council is lead by Agent Semer Kiya.
Go find her at our Imperial camp, the Russet Station. We don't know anything about the nature of these artifacts, but they are connected with what's going on in the Temple. Perhaps we will be able to find something that will help us to crack this magical field. Go there as fast as you can.

You were sent by Braid? Hmm. I am a representative of the City Council and I am responsible for making sure that the Empire doesn't lose any artifacts out here.
I also have the right to issue orders to any Imperial soldier, regardless of his accomplishments or medals. That means you, too.
Place yourself at the disposal of the Gallant Family at the League Camp on Coba Plateau.

The artifacts are gaining their power again, but this time it's dark power!
The new Holy cloaks strangle their owners and the blades wound them. The power of the artifacts is growing and they are becoming more and more expensive. All adventurers, pirates, and vagabonds are flooding the Plateau. The Holy Land is in uproar! The world has gone mad! Everyone is trying to make their share of the gold and no one cares that the Light is leaving and darkness is taking its place.
The League is pulling all its best troops into Coba Plateau, just to the East of Asee-Teph. That's where the vanguard is these days.
Our troops out there are led by the Gallant Family. We know them well, they're great guys.
Why don't you head out there too. Go to the Brazen Hill in the north, that's where the League camp is stationed. We're sure that help from such a specialist such as yourself will be appreciated.

Did the Peppy Family send you? That's excellent! The girls won't send just anyone to us.
It's crazy here. The Church of Light has declared all Dark Artifacts outside the law. The Great Inquisitor himself is visiting our camp. All in all, the situation is pretty tense. But... Welcome!
Find the Great Inquisitor, Afanasy Firov, in the League Camp on Coba Plateau.

We have some news.
While you were away, we attempted to penetrate the Temple of Tensess many times. We are frantically trying to find a way to break through the magical barrier. Obviously, the first faction to do this and save Tensess will win not just this battle, but the whole war! At this point in time, we haven't been able to break through the barrier, but our mages are adamant that they will be able to do it soon.
And the research into the influence of the demonic curve on the forces of Light needs to continue. That's why I'm sending you to the east, to Coba Plateau. The Brazen Hill is located in the northern part of the land, that's where our fortified camp is situated.
The War for the Artifacts is fierce, and we still don't know enough about them. It's quite possible that the key to the Temple of Tensess may be found somewhere on this plateau. You need to find the Great Inquisitor, Afanasy Firov. He knows everything about these terrifying forces.

I represent Inquisition - a special section of the Church of Light, created especially to keep an eye on the situation at Coba Plateau.
I'm warning you right away - the artifacts are outlawed. They are carriers of the Dark! The League is refusing to use them, but we must do all we can to prevent them from falling into Imperial hands. They won't stop at anything... If they had a chance, the Empire would even invite the Astral demons into their service!
Can you believe it, I'm the Great Inquisitor, and instead of doing my work and concerning myself with higher matters, I'm stuck checking soldiers' pockets! And every second one of them is carrying artifacts. It's unbelievable!
Kill 6 Smugglers on the Midnight Shore for Great Inquisitor Afanasy Firov in the League Camp.

We've cleared the camp of the vessels of darkness, but we can't honestly believe that the Light will suddenly shine into those souls.
Unfortunately, once you leave, their chests will be filled with new artifacts within a week. This disease must be destroyed completely! The followers of the darkness and filthy gold, which are the same thing in essence, have set up camp on the shore. They buy artifacts from our warriors, fuelling their greed for demonic riches. The Church hereby declares a crusade against the smugglers!

Warriors who are fully devoted to serving the League and the Light should attack artifact buyers of their own accord, but instead, they sneak off towards their camp at night to sell them! Pathetic heretics!
You've punished the smugglers? Praise the Imperishable Light! Let's see if they can find a use for their gold in their graves.
Take Imbued Water from a kobold and pour it on a Fire Trap to create a Combustion Climax for Gorislav Gipitsky.

I have a little job for you. The Rusted Wasteland has very special anomalies, we like to call them Fire Traps. And they produce some very valuable artifacts when mixed with a vial of kobold enchanted water.
They're valuable because of the risk and injuries that the Prospector takes to get them. First, you must take an enchanted water vial off a kobold, then you must find a fire trap, and then... And this is the tricky part... You have to let the fire trap light you on fire.
I know, I know! It's horrible! But luckily, you'll have the enchanted water. That'll extinguish the flames and create the item that we really want – the Combustion Climax! So, are you up for it?
Is it really that hard? You get the water and create the combustion climax. Easy.
Thank you! You now have the respect of the Prospectors.
Collect 5 Rare Tablecloths for Bertille de Pluie at the Prospectors' Inn.

Listen, the Historians have enough trouble dealing with the pirates and the goblins and just getting our hands on some real artifacts. And I'm talking real, valuable artifacts! Not those little trinkets that everyone loves to dig up from the anomalies! But I'm getting off topic...
We are lacking the tablecloths to put our finds on, let alone to lay the table.
Look, it would really help us if you could get us some rare tablecloths. I don't care how you get them, just hurry!
What? No, if I knew where to get them, I wouldn't be asking you!
Oh! Here they are! And they're even more lovely than I had thought they were going to be!
Collect 20 Rare Blankets for Gorislav Gipitsky.

Our El Dorado attract huge crowds. Some of the folks flee, but pretty many of them stay here for a long while.
This place is not made of elastic rubber! There's not enough room for everyone to sleep under shelter. So, naturally, a lot of them have to stay outside during the night time.
Have you ever tried to take a nap on the bare ground? I wonder if it's even possible - it's cold, and rough, and there are ants or bugs or gods know what else. Even if you manage to fall asleep, you will surely feel battered in the morning and won't be able to work properly. Thick warm blankets are on the biggest demand here.
Bring me some Rare Blankets, and the guys will be so grateful to you!
How goes it? Got the blankets yet? No, I can't tell you were to find them! That's your job!
Wonderful! We're going to feel really warm at cold nights!
Unearth the chest hidden under the Broken Demon Detector.

Oh... This broken detector is hiding a chest!
The hunters won't mind, right? It was they who set you on this hunt in the first place! It's like they wanted you to have it.
Wow! Be sure to thank the Demon Hunters next time you see them!
Find the hidden treasure on the Coba Plateau. Report back to Anastasia Leshcheva at the Prospectors' Inn.

Not far from the Demon Hunters' camp, in a place called the Isle of Weakness, I happened to see a fight between an orc prospector and the undead that roam there. Unfortunately, I didn't have time to help the poor guy. The prospector died in my arms.
His last words to me were about his stash. "Treasure, my treasure..." he whispered. And something about the Zem ruins, the astral shore... I don't know if this makes any sense to you... Maybe it's meant to confuse us! But go have a look around, maybe you'll find something valuable.
The area was strewn with the bones of miners - those who risked it all for the sake of profit... And lost.
You really found it?! That's wonderful news! Great job!
Kill 6 shadows on a small isle located in the south-eastern part of Coba Plateau. Report back to Mikhail Dukin at the Prospector's Inn.

In the south-eastern part of Coba Plateau Shadows Isle is located. Weird place! That's why it is called like that.
Shadows are Masters of the Isle. Suppose, some heritage of Tep. By the way, this isle might become a very good camp for prospectors.
But first of all we need to clear it from Shadows.
Do you want to help?Then go to this isle and kill Shadows.
Shadows Isle is the place where you can help us.

Well done.
You can do this task regularly. It does good for everyone.
Kill 6 Wretched Vultures on the northern shore of Coba Plateau. Report back to Mikhail Dukin at the Prospector's Inn.

Many prospectors tried to reach anomalies from the northern shore of Coba Plateau. But in vain!
Jackals rule on the northern coast. We are nothing but food for them.
I wish we solve this problem forever. How? By killing all the Jackals, of course!

When we have killed all the Jackals, we can open a new path to anomalies.
And the more paths to reach Darkness artifacts, the better.

Well done.
You can do this task regularly. It does good for everyone.
Kill 8 Vicious Centipedes and return to the Guardian of the Future.

Hey... Listen... While you are here, I wanted to ask you to help me with a private problem.
You know, I hate insects and other crawling creatures. I loathe them! And these centipedes around... Ugh! They are so disgusting!
Please help me to get rid of them.
I'm not a gibberling, not an orc, not an elf, not even a human. Still, I can understand the human needs.
Thank you. It helped a lot.

Are you willing to help me? Great!
Defenders of The Sweety are so brave - orcs, goblins, everyone! They withstand injuries and never step back. But everything has the limits of strength, even metal, not to say mortal beings.
There is a way to put the soldiers back on track. Even injured will be able to continue fighting if they drink Berserkin! It's a special potion based on... no matter! You are not supposed to know it.
The problem is that I left Berserkin in my first aid kit. Find it in the eastern part of The Sweety!
Give Berserkin to 12 soldiers. We must put them on foot!
Demons! Who could have expected them?!
I already hear the cheering of our soldiers. It means that Berserkin works.

Let's see what you are good for.
These cursed demons run all over my Sweety. I hate them! Especially scouts. Nasty creatures!
They are getting everywhere, crushing and destroying my ship!
And the Predators that come afterwards - they hunt for survivors, trying to finish them off!
If you want to help, eliminate both kinds of these creatures.
I didn't build my Sweety for these ugly cockroaches to destroy it!

The demons are destroyed.
So at least you are good for something!
Bring 4 repair parts to Yasskul Stakh.

The Sweety is all my life. All I my knowledge is embodied here, in her mechanism.
How do you think I feel with all these demons taking it apart?! I'm nearly collapsing! We have to repair The Sweety. It's idling now, but if we manage to fix the mechanism...
These giant blades will cut through the rock and we'll drill to the large vein of meteorite ore! If you are telling the truth and this meteorite ore scares demons off... Well, they will have a hard time!
The main problem is that the controls are not working, and we need spare parts for repair. They can be found in boxes scattered around The Sweety.
Can you find and bring me 4 repair parts? Then I'll believe your story!
If I ever repair my Sweety... That would be great!

Here, give me the parts! We need to repair the controls first.
Well, you are good, really good! Now I think I can trust you.
There is an especially dangerous demon hiding upstairs, near the control room.
We can't start The Sweety while it's alive!
Bring the Dragon's Heart to Klavdia.

My daddy wants to make sure you are loyal to him. He asked me to remind you of your agreement. Remember, he believes in you. He knows that Yasker and Eniel trust you, too. Only one of them will receive the Dragon's Heart! My daddy is waiting for you to make the right decision.
Here it is, right in front of you. Use the power of Eternal Fire to break through the Flaming Guards and retrieve the Heart!
Do you have something for me?
You did the right thing. Daddy will be so glad!
Perform all Collector's tasks to receive your reward.

I bet you are wondering why you waste time helping this crazy collector?
Don't try to dignify yourself. I know that the safety of the past means little to you. I understand people's motives a bit.
When you complete all of my tasks, I will reward you generously.
Well? Is my last errand complete?
Bring Vlad's diary to the Warden of the Past.

You've done a lot to preserve and research the Past. I hope you will render me another service.
I'm talking about Vlad's diary. Chronicles mention of him as of a Great Mage, but some researchers believe he was just a watchdog for Nezeb. Anyway, he was an interesting person. If he hadn't been a Great Mage, how come he lived that long? His name was on the list of those saved during the Igsh Cataclysm! His correspondence with Korleone, another ambiguous figure of the Past, is also available. To cut it short, I'm very curious about this habitant of Kirah.
Sooner or later you'll find him. Our employer, known as Gorislav, said so.
I need Vlad's diary. Bring it to me.

Vlad has one unquestionable merit.
He's writing his diary diligently.
Yes, this is his diary. One day you will read it, and I'm sure you will be satisfied!
Have you dealt with the demons?
Demonic organs of vision work differently from ours. How exactly? We will find out soon.

We have a unique opportunity to study the demons of the past.
As you may know, these beasts evolve over time. Several years ago a new type of demons had been noticed. They can stay outside of the Astral much longer than their predecessors.
The Wormfaces are interested in their sense organs. Demonic tactile abilities are perfect. They can feel minimal fluctuations of temperature and emotional condition of their victim.
That's why you must get us 10 demon skin patches.
Have you dealt with the demons?
Demons can feel, though in their own demonical way. How? The Wormfaces will tell us.

We have a unique opportunity to study the demons of the past.
As you may know, these beasts evolve over time. Several years ago a new type of demons had been noticed. They can stay outside of the Astral much longer than their predecessors.
The Wormfaces are interested in their sense organs.
That's why they are asking us to get 1 Resonating Demon Crystals that help these creatures to hear everything even on the far end of the Astral.
Have you dealt with the demons?
Demons can hear, in their own demonical way. The Wormfaces will tell us how exactly.
Bring 4 Crocosaur Bones to the Warden of the Past.

Interfering the time has its consequences. Every now and then, creatures of the past tear through the Fabric of Time and break into our world. Strange creatures called Crocosaurs that lived here before the Cataclysm were seen here, on Kirah!
I'd like you to destroy these dangerous creatures, so we can study their bones. Remember, you won't be able to find them at any moment. Check your calendar to see if the time is right.
Well done. We will send these bones to the Wormfaces.
Bring a Bone of the Giant Crocosaur to the Warden of the Past.

We don't have much time... This is one of our last chances to study the past.
Giant Crocosaurs break through the thinned Fabric of Time every now and then. Bring me one of their bones - Wormfaces are very interested in them.
Did you find the Giant Crocosaurs?

Wormfaces discovered an Astral residue in the bones of ancient creatures that lived here before the Cataclysm.
Can you imagine? If it's true, we should reconsider everything we knew about the world!
Bring the White Flower to the Warden of the Past.

Have you ever heard of a Great Tree?
This is a living being that supports the existence of the world itself, preventing its destruction! You can't find one easily these days. One Great Tree grows in Kania, and another on a faraway Yakhch allod.
Thousands years ago such tree grew on Kirah, too. We can use its fascinating powers by gathering its flowers - they will hold off the Astral and help us to fight demons in our time. Flowers differ in color and rarity.
For now, I'm asking you to bring me a white flower. Its powers are not the strongest, but you will be able to find it easily among the common desert bushes.
Have you found the White Flower?

Yes, it's the flower I told you about! Delicate and defenseless.
But it holds great powers, and we will find good use for it.
Bring the Purple Flower to the Warden of the Past.

Now I need you to find me a much rarer blossom of the Great Tree - a Purple Flower.
White flower is just a sketch of the future giant, it's weak and fretful. Purple Flower contains stubbornness of powerful roots and insuperable strength of growth.
But this flower is also much more difficult to find. Try searching it among the desert bushes.
Have you found the Purple Flower?
Bring 5 Red Flowers to the Warden of the Past.

I admire your persistence!
Maybe you'll manage to accomplish the impossible and find the Red Flowers of the Great Tree? They hide among the desert bushes and contain great powers that can crush boulders! Red Flower can strike roots even into the stone burnt by lava, and it's extremely rare to find.
I wish you best of luck!
Have you found the Red Flowers?
What a powerful plant! It trembles in my hands like a beast, not a simple flower!
Bring 10 Black Flowers to the Warden of the Past.

My new request for you sounds more like a prayer of hope.
Would you have the luck to find a Black Flower of the Great Tree among the desert bushes? This flower alone will justify our travels through time. This is the essence of the Great Tree! Throw it overboard of an Astral ship, and a handful of soil will surround it. Soon it will grow into a whole new allod! Is there anything more precious in the world devoured by the Astral?
Have you found the Black Flowers?

I can't believe my eyes!
It's the Black Flower! The conqueror of Chaos!

Do you want to help me with studying different Kirah creatures? They are of a great interest to us!
The beasts from the times when there were no demons, no Astral encroaching, when there was balance in the world!
Do you think they are different from our time? Of course they are! This is why we want to study them.
Let's start with Centipedes. Bring me their antennae, and remember, they must remain intact. It will help us to understand how the demon invasion affected our world.
Have you found Intact Centipede Antennae?
Great, I'll send them to the Wormfaces. They will study all your findings. Their knowledge is vast, and they will be able to determine the nature of these artifacts.

You are so good at field research! I have a new task for you.
We are going to study Desert Vultures, and I want you to bring me 10 of their tail feathers.

Thank you!
I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.
You are so good at field research! I have a new task for you. We are going to study Desert Tarantulas, and I want you to bring me their mandibles.

Thank you!
I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.
You are so good at field research! I have a new task for you. We are going to study Desert Cobras, and I want you to bring me 1 of their fangs.

Thank you!
I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.

Thank you!
I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.
Bring 10 Intact Scorpion Stings to the Warden of the Past.

Again, I need your help in researching the creatures that lived a hundred years ago. Demons started their invasion, and all living beings are now affected by the Astral. The Wormfaces are trying to examine the changes in Kirah inhabitants.
They need 10 intact scorpion stings for their studies.
Thank you! I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.

Again, I need your help in researching the creatures that lived a hundred years ago. Demons started their invasion, and all living beings are now affected by the Astral. The Wormfaces are trying to examine the changes in Kirah inhabitants.
They need clots of darkness for their studies. They can be found in a pool of darkness that remains after you defeat a shadow. Wormfaces suggest that these strange creatures can resist the Astral.
Thank you! I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.

Again, I need your help in researching the creatures that lived a hundred years ago. Demons started their invasion, and all living beings are now affected by the Astral. The Wormfaces are trying to examine the changes in Kirah inhabitants.
They need 10 essences of the magic energy for their studies. They can be collected after you defeat elementals.
Thank you! I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.

Again, I need your help in researching the creatures that lived a hundred years ago. Demons started their invasion, and all living beings are now affected by the Astral. The Wormfaces are trying to examine the changes in Kirah inhabitants.
They need crawler hearts for their studies. For thousand of years the Wormfaces observed crawlers living in their caves, so they were happy to know there is a chance of studying them.
I hope that the Wormfaces are finally satisfied. I personally think that they should have discovered these secrets much earlier!
You are so good at field research! I have a new task for you. We are going to study Searing Eyes, and I want you to bring me 10 of them.

Thank you!
I will send your findings to the Wormfaces.
Kill the unusual demon, collect the magic artifact and bring it to the Guardian of the Future.

It looks like the Spirit is trying to show me something... What's this? A demon resembling the Destroyer that attacked me...
But this one is more powerful and more dangerous. I suppose the Spirit wants me to destroy this monster, to collect something magical... and... I don't understand. A ghostly dragon... Ruins...
Only one face looks familiar. The face of the Guardian of the Future. Not much...
I should return to Kirah. And if I meet this horrible demon, I'll fight and defeat him. The Charm of the Astral Silver will help me.
Do you have anything to brag about?

Where did you get it?
Tell me!
Although this stone looks no different from the others, intuition tells you to inspect it carefully.
I was right! I knew it!
Find the treasure, then return to the Guardian of the Future.

You might have learned that treasures can be found in different parts of our world, especially when you don't expect them.
Kirah is no exception. There is a chance that eventually you will stumble across a strange stone with a chest buried under it... But will you be able to find it?
Well done! Your experience is invaluable!
Charge the device with the Ashes of the Past and collect information about 24 creatures of Kirah, then return to the Guardian of the Future.

Historical investigations don't just mean collecting rare artifacts. We must also study the creatures that lived a long time ago.
You can help me with that. I'll give you a special device that gathers a lot of information about an object in a short period of time. You should charge it with the Ashes of the Past to make it work. The device will tell you which creature on Kirah represents the most interest right now. Find it, point the device at it and press the button.
After that, a new target will be chosen. Remember, the act of examination will make a creature... dissatisfied, to say the least.
So be careful. Examine 24 creatures, then come back to me.
How are you getting on with your explorations?
Perfect! This information can be very useful, especially if we are going to continue our time travels.
Find Sarang Ma and give him the Ashes of the Past to send him back into his world.

Oh! Another potential victim of time traveling! Yes, a victim! Just like my friend Sarang Ma, a Historian who wanted to solve a riddle of Vlad, the Great Mage of Kirah. Sarang Ma arrived here and started jumping from one past to another!
Now he can't understand where and when he is. Poor thing, he got lost in time!
Please find him and help him come back into the present.
You will need the Ashes of the Past to do it.
I understand losing the Ashes of the Past is painful. But there is no other way to help Sarang Ma!
Thank you. I hope Sarang Ma will come to his senses now.

Unlike other Time Wanderers, I can see the bright side in this situation.
There are unique creatures called desert crawlers that you can only find on Kirah. Their counterparts on Holy Land are much weaker. Their shells are made of extremely hard plates, their pincers contain unusual paralyzing poison, and their meat is the best medicine for... well, for men's problems.
This is why I want you to gather all these parts for me.
By the way, I'm in good repute with the Time Wanderers, so I can say a good word for you if you help me with the crawlers.

You help me, and I help you.
For our mutual benefit!
Thank you. I'll be waiting for you tomorrow.
Prevent the battle between the League and the Empire and return to Gorislav on the Crossroads.

As you might have guessed, your main goal is preventing the tomorrow's battle. League and Empire armies are ready to cut each other throats, but instead they must repulse the demonic attack, uniting against their common enemy.
How can you do it? By completing tasks of Yasker and others.
I hope you understand that "tomorrow" is just a figure of speech. It is always March 3, 910 here. Every day. This day won't end until you reach your goal. After that you'll be able to meet Gorislav and receive new tasks.

Fine! It means tomorrow Yasker and Eniel will meet the demons fully prepared.
But there's no tomorrow. There is only one and the same day that took place a century ago. And if they succeeded or failed, we will find out later.
Now you see how confusing the time can be!
Light up 5 Lamps of Time on your way to the Imperial Camp and meet Fang the Nomadic.

There you are. Are you going to scatter the Ashes over the heads of the poor ancestors? Hold it!
Listen to some safety precautions first.
You're a time Traveler from the future. Only you can see the Whirlpool of Time, the Wall of Time that separates this part of reality from another, and other signs of magic interfering with the past. None of these things exist for those who belong to this time. Still, people here are well aware of the war. For Kanians, Gibberlings and elves you are just an enemy, one of the many. They will attack you on sight.
But worry not - the Gift of Tensess is with you! If you die, you will resurrect either in the Whirlpool of Time or near another source of time, able to go on with your quest.
Don't try to do everything in one day. Tomorrow here will be March 3, 910 again, and you will be able to make another attempt.
Now go to the Imperial Camp in the northeastern Kirah. Follow the path. You can't miss it. You will see 5 Lamps of Time along the way. Touch them all. It's an important ritual. It'll make you a real traveler in time. You mark the path for those who follow you later.
The war is such a mess. The Empire soldiers will most likely reckon you are one of them. Especially if you don't sing songs from the future and show off your mana batteries. You look strange, of course, but it will do for your mission. Go to the Imperial camp and report to general Fang the Nomadic that the League troops have landed on the southeastern coast of Kirah. It's true, by the way.
How do I know? I read history books!
Report properly! I won't tolerate a lack of discipline!

What?! The League dogs infiltrated through our defenses?! To arms!
Who are you? Where are you from? Strange uniform... Nevermind, we'll sort it all out later!
Kill 3 League Assailants and the Resolute Family, then meet Yasker on Kirah.

Your persistence is praiseworthy. I can see that you believe in your righteousness and you will do anything to prove it.
I'm almost ready to comply and cancel the tomorrow's battle. But there is only one problem. The League troops are in the rear. I can't issue this order until the threat is eliminated...
The main battle is planned for tomorrow... But wouldn't it be better to wait a little?

Congratulations! You made it! The battle against the League won't take place tomorrow. We are preparing for the demon assault.
I hope tomorrow I'll be killing Astral beasts, not writing an explanatory note to Nezeb!
Earn trust of the Kirah Regiment and talk to Yasker again.

Thank Nezeb, we at the Empire are not spineless slugs like these League scum, we don't need to follow the voice of the majority. I make decisions here, and thousands of people comply. But if I show my trust to a newcomer, my soldiers will start questioning it. You have to become friends with my people. Only after that I'll be able to issue the order you want.
Complete the tasks to make Kirah soldiers and officers happy, earn their trust, then we'll talk.
Do you have anything to brag about?

My soldiers and officers see you as friend.
I'm glad to know it.
Use the device to find the stealthed League Scouts, collect 50 Gibberling Ears and bring them to Fang the Nomadic.

Damn! What are you talking about? What future? I don't understand it one bit!
This is war! People are getting killed here. Hordes of gibberlings are sneaking around the camp, slaughtering our soldiers! Don't stand still or you'll die without much talking.
Wait... Holy Shaman! What if... you are a League spy!
Why are you shaking your head? How can I trust you? You don't even have an insignia!
Look, do you really want to earn my trust? Bring me 50 gibberling ears.
Too much? Well guess what - they always come in packs of three! One group, six ears. Go to the northwest and use this device to expose the gibberlings. I'm not sure how it works, sort it out yourself.
Meanwhile, I'll think of your story... Traveler from the future, damn you...
What a strange day... Everything was so clear in the morning.

Aha. Ears. Of gibberlings. 50 of them. Got it.
What can I say... You did well!
Run away from guards without fighting them, then meet Yasker and ask him for protection.

League worm! I bet you didn't think I'd check all lists, all registers! None of them mentions you, and it can only mean you're a darned spy!
You are darned spy. Get away these ears from me - we all know that ruthless skunks like you never spare lives of your own people! Guess it's not a big deal for you to knock off a dozen of gibberlings?
Guards! Arrest this scum!

Did Fang jump on you? He's a good soldier, but sometimes he goes beyond the marks.
I don't think you're a League agent. Your story is too complicated for a spy. I'm not going to arrest you. At least until all the circumstances are clarified.
And don't try to speak with Fang anymore. I'm afraid he'll kill you on sight.
Bring Yasker an issue of The Imperial Herald, a Tentacle of Kixxar the Keeper and a letter from the present-day Yasker.

It's hard to believe you... Especially when you say that I'm going to succeed the Great Nezeb, hallowed be his name, and become the leader of the Empire!
Wait. Your clothes... are they from the future, too? So you can bring other items here?
That's the solution. Bring me something to prove your words. I heard a lot about the great Empire from you. Bring me a daily newspaper from the future. I'm sure Nezebgrad traders will sell you one.
The demons you mentioned, are they made of flesh? Bring me something demonic as a proof of their existence... Tentacle of... What's his name again you mentioned... Kixxar the Keeper!
And most importantly, bring me a letter confirming you are not a League spy. Written and signed by me... "Yasker, Leader of the Empire".
These items will make me believe you.
I didn't expect to see you again...

I can't believe it...
Year 1011 newspaper, my name on every page...
Look at this tentacle... It's disgusting! Is that what demons look like?
And the most important thing! A letter signed by me! Yasker, Leader of the Empire... Who could've think of it?
Fill the bottle with water from the Whirlpool of Time and bring it to Negus Tot.

Surely you understand that I don't trust you. I'm a Zem scientist, and my job is to doubt everything.
But you have a chance to prove your words. In a scientific way, of course.
You told me of the Whirlpool of Time located somewhere on Kirah. Was it filled with water or some other substance? Doesn't matter. I'd like to have a look at it. Of course I won't go there by myself. Take the bottle and fill it with water from the Whirlpool of Time. I might need it for a couple of experiments.
Time travels, changing the past... Sounds magnificent!

What's this? Did you fill the bottle?
Well, let's see what the Time is!
Use the dagger to kill yourself in front of Negus Tot, then resurrect and talk to Negus Tot again.

Are you trying to mess with me? The bottle is empty! I should have called guards a long time ago...
Although... taking your words into consideration... It seems your insanity has a certain pattern. I remember you told me that I couldn't see the Whirlpool of Time and the wall... Apparently, this is why I can't see anything in this bottle.
But don't rejoice yet. I still don't believe in your stories about demons, the death of the Great Nezeb and the Gift of Tensess!
Wait, of course you can convince me. You told me that you can resurrect after death. Prove it. Here is my dagger. Cut your throat right now, then resurrect and come back to me. If I see you alive... I'll believe you!

Great Nih!
I can see you! And it means... So your story is true?!
Where the science suffered a defeat, religion triumphed!
Deliver a letter from Negus Tot to Yasker on Kirah.

Is it really true? Dreams of my people have been finally fulfilled! Immortality is possible!
If demonic attack endowed us with the Gift of Tensess... Maybe we'd better not to intervene? I have to think it over.
So you want me to prove your words for Yasker? I can do it. I'll write everything down...
Here it is. This paper with my signature will confirm that you are from the future. I believe you. I believe in many things now...

What's this? A message from Negus Tot?
Hm... Well, it proves your story... I wonder what you did to surprise him.
Find a League time traveler, persuade them to talk to Yasker and escort them to the Imperial camp.

Let's sum it up.
Fang the Nomadic thinks you are a League spy. He would gladly execute you at any time.
Negus Tot trusts you completely. However, questions of life and death are a thorny subject for Zem people. Your resurrection could be a perfect trick that makes other people trust you.
I'm the one to make a decision. Well, I believe you. You gave me enough evidence. But I must put you to one more test, for the last time.
You told me there were other guests from the future on Kirah. Just like you, they are trying to persuade the League to stop the war. I would like to see such a person. Bring them here, in our camp. My order will guarantee the safety for both of you.
Great changes are coming. I can feel it!

Yes. They confirmed your words.
I looked into their eyes and I saw confidence. I don't need any more proofs.
Kill 7 Kobold Miners and 7 League Veterans in the Blazing Mine.

I believe that you are from the future, and that some Astral beasts are going to attack us tomorrow. I even believe that I will become a leader of the great Empire one day.
But I'm not going to issue any orders about retreating, regrouping or something like that. This is war! The League wants our land, our meteorite ore! If I withdraw the troops right now, agents of the City Council will arrest me by the end of the day, and your future will shatter.
No, first we must turn the tide of the war. And you are going to help us.
We are fighting for the meteorite ore in the central Kirah. Kobold miners brought here by the League are already prospecting our deposits! You must kill the invaders.
Are demons more dangerous than the League? Hm...
If all Empire citizens are as loyal as you, I'll be glad to become your leader!
Collect 5 tentacles from the Twisted Predators on Kirah and nail them to the pole at the northern Imperial camp, then return to Fang the Nomadic.

Hi there! How is it going?
Come on! Don't look at me like that. I was wrong, I should've believed you. My bad. It happens to everyone! Okay, let's be friends. We have a lot of things to do.
These demons... Wicked bastards! They are dangerous. Even I shake in my shoes when I see them. What can I expect from the others?
I showed the tentacle you brought from the future to our soldiers after the roll call, to reassure them that the enemy can be defeated. It worked, at first. But now it's rotten, decayed and stinks terribly.
In short, it's no longer advertizable. We need a few more tentacles.
Bring five of them to the north of our camp. Nail them to the pole, so everyone will see!
My soldiers are brave guys. It's just they don't like anything they can't understand.

I already got a complaint that one of our ensigns beat a greenhorn with a tentacle! He tore it off the pole and gave the guy a good slap in the face!
Good sign. Once they were afraid to come near it, and now they casually use it in a brawl. You see, propaganda works!
Place the Standard near the portal to seal it.

Yes! We are going to destroy this portal. We'll prevail where Negus Tot failed. Demons will never reach the meteorite ore, Kirah will be saved!
Go ahead, traveler from the future! Raise the Standard!
I've been waiting for you. I wanted to say thanks.

What are you saying? A strange demon attacked you? A demon that even you have never seen before?!
Hm... I'm sorry, but I have nothing to tell you. Return to your time and ask those who sent you here.
Raise the Standard, then talk to Fang the Nomadic.

Attention! Eyes on Standard!
Damn... I forgot to bring it out in a ceremonial manner. Nevermind, let's consider it a downside effect of the war.
Here, I present you the Standard of our Regiment. It isn't just a piece of cloth, it's a magic item. Try raising it, and you'll see.
Come on! Raise the Battle Standard!

You see! It's perfect. It will help you to kill demons and save us all.
Yes, I know about your future task. Don't let us down!
Collect Clots of Astral Energy from the demons of Kirah and bring them to Yasker, along with the Standard.

Listen to me carefully. There is a large meteorite ore deposit northwest from our camp. I believe it's richer than the Blazing Mine reserves. We were going to use Mecha-Mole, a huge mining machine created by the best Empire engineer Yasskul Stakh to gather ore there. And judging by the fact that the demons are drawing to this area, we were moving in the right direction. If only the League and the Astral beasts stopped their attacks...
Anyway, no time for regrets. I'm sure the demons want to destroy the deposit. You are supposed to defeat them.
Negus Tot examined the remains of the demons killed near the camp, and he believes that their Astral energy will help us to upgrade the Standard. We just need to collect this energy. It will help you in your battle.
I hope Negus Tot was right. He's a talented scientist and manager. I don't want to lose him...

Fine, let's follow the instructions and upgrade the Battle Standard.
Step aside...
Place the Standard on top of Mecha-Mole and protect it while it absorbs the powers of defeated enemies, then summon Yasker's twin.

Once The Sweety gets to the meteorite ore deposits, the demons will be weakened. But there is something else we should do first.
There is a ancient magic rite related to the Standard: when someone wins a battle under the emblem of his regiment and survives, the Standard fulfills any wish of the champion. I've never seen this magic myself, but Fang assured me that it works this way. We'll see.
Go upstairs, to the control cabin. Place the Standard there and protect it from the enemies. Summon me once the rite is completed.
So how did it come out?
Even as a twin I can feel that its magic properties have changed... Great! Our efforts are not in vain!

At last!
I've been waiting for you. Although we were prepared for the attack, demons pummeled us heavily. It's hard to imagine what would happen if you didn't warn us.
Now we are holding our positions, but the meteorite ore reserves which keep the Astral at bay are still at risk...
I will supervise our next operation personally, and I want to give you an important task. Magic Elementals dwell in the vicinity of our camp. It's a great advantage for us - you can collect magical charges from these creatures to support a powerful spell... What spell? I'll tell you later.
The recent news disturbs me. More and more demons are coming!
The charges are here. Great, just in time!
Plant three magical bombs at the first group of demonic portals, then report to Negus Tot.

Here you are! I've been thinking about you all this time. This news of the immortality is incredible!
I look forward to the moment when the Gift of Tensess shows up. The demons attacked all allods at the same time! Does it mean that Tensess is already dead? In this case, maybe we can die already, to find ourselves in this... Purgatory?
No, I'll wait! Even if I resurrect, Yasker will kill me a couple times more. He has become so tough, so imperious! War changes people... He asked me to find a way of destroying the demonic portals. Can you help me?
I've made three bombs operating on three different principles of magic. We need to test them. Place them near the portals and see what happens. We'd better use the first group of portals, they are somewhat larger than the newer ones. They stood there for a long time, so there is a chance that their powers weakened and the bombs will work.
And one more thing. The tests should be performed at different portals to make the results more reliable.
We must survive through this hell and wait for our resurrection...
What? It didn't work?! Yasker will eat me alive with all my prostheses! We must think of something else...
Summon Yasker's twin on top of the hill and talk to him, then return to the Imperial camp.

Here it is - the Charm of Summoning, charged with my outstanding magical powers. You can use it to summon my twin to report about your achievements and receive new orders.
Now you have to test the charm. Go to the west. Climb the hill and activate the charm. My twin will appear. Talk to him, then return to me. I'd like to issue the main order personally.
Having a twin helps a lot. I might need it in the future. When... um... when I rule the country.
Repel the demonic attack at the northern Imperial Outpost, then use the charm to summon Yasker's twin.

As far as I know, you have already received the Standard and helped Negus Tot to construct a new bomb. You might need both these items later.
For now, I want you to perform a reconnaissance mission for me. There is an outpost to the north of our camp protecting the road to the Big Mine. We have lost contact with its garrison, and I want you to find out what happened. I'm afraid the demons have reached the place. Use the Standard to fight them. Summon my twin when you're done.
Oh my... Looking at this camp is more than enough to make a decision.

My fears came true! The platoon has been destroyed! We won't be able to use this outpost as a base of operations.
Come back to the camp.
Use the Standard to kill demons and get to Mecha-Mole, then summon Yasker's twin.

Now you can go to the Big Mine. There is a good chance that demons will attack you on your way to the Mecha-Mole. The upgraded Standard will help you to deal with them.
Find the Mecha-Mole and summon my twin, I'll tell you what to do next.
I didn't expect that many demons!

It proves my theory...
As Nezeb says: "You are on the right way, comrades"!
Offer your help to Yasskul Stakh. Earn his trust, then summon Yasker's twin.

Mecha-Mole is barely operational...
This child of Yasskul Stakh is tough. You should meet this guy. He hates everything that is not a mechanism. You know, he gave a name to this monstrous machine - "The Sweety"!
Find him and offer your help. Earn his trust, and he will help us. After that, summon me.
So? Does the Great Engineer show his favor to you?

All right! Aha! So Stakh plans to set free his Sweety...
Sounds amazing!
Use the lever to start up the machine. Defeat the demons, then summon Yasker's twin.

Go ahead! Start up the engine!
As soon as the Mecha-Mole starts working, the demons will try to stop it. You will have to fight them. And don't use the magic of the Consecrated Standard yet. We will need it at a later point.

The enemy can use this portal to get to meteorite ore.
This is where you should use the Standard!
Deliver Yasker's letter from the past to future Yasker in Nezebgrad.

We held out against the League, fought off the demons, but... We can't consider it a victory. We paid too much for it.
We are leaving Kirah. We need to protect our people against the demons. Soon I will open the portal, and we will start the evacuation.
It's hard to be defeated. And I'll do anything to make this defeat the last one in my life.
You can help me. I'm holding over the evacuation because there is one more thing I have to do here, on Kirah.
I need an advise of a person from the future, who knows everything about the demons. I'm talking about future myself.
Here. This is the letter for the future Yasker, the Leader of the Empire. I need his answer. Bring it to me, and don't even think to read it! I won't tolerate it, neither in this time, nor in the future.
What do you want? Is it urgent?

What's this? A letter from me?!
Let me have a look.
Get back to your time and meet Yasker.

You have kept your promise: the Heart is mine. Now it's time for you to learn something.
The Heart is a great artifact. The Great Mages use it as a source of their powers, but it can also be used as a weapon. A powerful one-time charge capable of killing any enemy. The nature of these powers is not yet clear even to the Great Mages. We only know that there are 12 such artifacts in the world. In the past, the Great Dragons were among them.
Things have changed now, the Dragons are almost gone, but the Heart is still in full power, and it will allow me to defeat... No, not Nezeb. I'm faithful to the Leader.
I will use this artifact to destroy that traitor Gorluxor! Our confrontation is inevitable. I remember your story: he's going to try and seize the power, becoming my worst enemy. He will lose and defect to cultists, causing us a lot of troubles.
But I will use the Heart to change everything. You are going to return into the better world, there will be no Gorluxor, no crimes. We were fighting for this together... me, you and Yasker, the Great Leader of the Empire.
Go and meet him. A whole new world awaits you.

Come in. We have a lot to discuss.
I remember everything. Everything. How we first met on Kirah, my initial distrust to you. Then I believed you, wrote myself a letter, read an answer again and again, dreaming of a better world...
Did I mention that I can admit my mistakes? The Heart was one of them. I had no other options but to use it early. During the war I encountered Eniel de Ardeur, a Great Mage of the League. I've heard of him before, when we both were on Kirah, but we never met in person.
He came to the fight well prepared. In the previous timeline, I managed to kill him. But League time travelers warned the mage. To prevent the defeat, he decided to retrieve the Heart for himself.
Two Hearts of the Dragon clashed against each other. I had to use mine to survive. One power absorbed another...
I failed to change the future. Is it possible at all?
A short time ago I couldn't remember anything about this fight with Eniel. And now I have a scar on my shoulder. It appeared by itself. Along with it came the memory of you, of Kirah, of the Heart...
It's so confusing. I believe the games with Time should be played by Gods, not us, mortals.
But one thing I remember for sure: I promised you a reward! It's time to keep my word.
Deliver the letter to Yasker in the past.
Here are the instructions for the past me. They will allow me to realize my plans. And you have to help me. I will never forget it if you will.
I hope my plan won't be a complete failure...

Here is the letter!
Well... Well. Yes, everything's clear. I see that in the future I have great powers. Collecting all this information in one day...
The might of the Empire is so impressive!
Collect all ingredients required for your training to complete Yasker's task.

The most valuable resource in the world is time. Unlike you, I'm short on it.
A mystery that I'm going to reveal will be the price for your time.
There is another important resource on Kirah, much more valuable than the meteorite ore. I believe the real reason behind the attack of the League is the Heart of the Great Dragon guarded by an elite squad of Nezeb Falcons. I can't control them, they are subordinate to our great Leader...
Don't look at me like that! He's still the Leader. Although my current plans are not coordinated with him, I remain faithful to the Great Nezeb!
We need to evacuate the Heart, so neither the League nor the demons would capture it.
The problem is, one must undergo a special training to approach the Heart and take it. It lasts for 4 days. I don't have this time. But you... Complete the first step, then come back to this day, repeat it until you're done.
Can I count on you?
If it works out... The world will be so much better!

You did well.
I'm sure we will prevail. You aren't working for me alone, your effort are for the future!

Every day brings you closer to the victory.
But for me this is the same painful day forever.

Fine. Now I can create a Sign of Superiority...
Here it is.

There are demonic portals on the way to the Secret Cave that must be closed. Otherwise, there is a chance that the demons will stab you in the back.

Demonic portals use the same principles as ours. You can attune to their portal to become a Guardian and get the full control over it. It won't be easy, though.

You will be able collect one particle of the portal at a time.

Bring me 10 particles, and I'll create a shard you need to complete your mission.
In this letter, me-from-the-future is praising you. It seems you have helped me with different problems. Very well.

Let me create a shard...
Here it is! Be careful with it.
In proper time I went through this training, too. Like everyone else...
I will create the magical clot we need.
Bring the Dragon's Heart to Yasker.

The time has come for you to perform another great deed for the glory of the Empire.
Listen carefully. You are going to cross the bridge to the north, find the demonic portal and seal it. After that, kill the Archdemon.
When it's done, convince Vlad, the commander of the elite squad of Nezeb Falcons that guard the cave, to give you the key. If they refuse to let you in, I order you to overcome their resistance. Break into the cave and get the Heart of the Dragon.
The future of the world depends on the success of this operation...

Yes! This is the Dragon's Heart!
The world is saved!

What? You want to get into the cave and collect the Heart of the Dragon?!
Who are you? How do you know about the Heart?
Don't move! I'll know everything about you in a second...

What a stupid story is this? A Director with a newspaper? Or... Yasker who decided to take place of the Great Nezeb? Planning to become a leader of the Empire?
Take this traitor away!
Find the artifact from the past on Kirah, then return to the Guardian of the Future.

If you even traveled on the Melting Isle, you know that the Global Warming revealed ancient June treasures there that were hidden for centuries under the layer of ice.
Our interfering with the time works in the same manner. The energy of Reality emits every now and then, exposing the ancient treasures here and there. Find them to clear Kirah from the artifacts of the past and get something useful for yourself.
Be sure to keep your eyes open all the time.
Excellent. You see? It's good both for you and for me, a 100 year old keeper of Kirah.
Race through all checkpoints and return to Sarang Kamau.

Do you know what I enjoy most of all?
Speed! Movement! Energy! I'm sure one day we will create a very fast self-moving transport.
But now, we ride horses. Not as fast as we want, but better than nothing.
Are you interested in racing? Want to take part in a competition? Then come to the right place at the right time and wait for a signal to start. Ride along with other participants, and pass six checkpoints in the correct order to complete the race.
Three riders who finish first will bring glory to their guilds, increasing their Prestige.

Motion is life.
You understand it better when you ride at full speed across the sandy dunes of Kirah...
You made it to the finish. Great!
Race through all checkpoints and return to Horsewomen Family.

Do you know what I enjoy most of all?
Speed! Movement! Energy! I'm sure one day we will create a very fast self-moving transport. But now, we ride horses. Not as fast as we want, but better than nothing.
Are you interested in racing? Want to take part in a competition? Then come to the right place at the right time and wait for a signal to start. Ride along with other participants, and pass six checkpoints in the correct order to complete the race. Three riders who finish first will bring glory to their guilds, increasing their Prestige.
Once we participated in the most exciting races: we were trying to tame a giant orc. One artist even painted a picture of this! Of course, in reality it didn't turn out that smooth...

Anyway, we got distracted.
Congratulations! The race is finished.
Deliver the Instructions on the Ashes of the Past to the Second Time Wanderer.

My friend and I are preparing for an important experiment. We are going to use the Ashes of the Past on the same creature in different time streams. Right after that we will attempt to affect its mind in the opposite ways. I can't wait to see what happens! The latest ideas will replace the previous ones? Or will they merge, creating a bizarre mixture? Or maybe we will witness a temporal schizophrenia?
In short, this is an extremely important experiment. This package contains instructions for my colleague. Bring it to her.
She is somewhere on Kirah, the only question is in which time...
Where are you from? From what time?

Do you have a package from my colleague?
Excellent! Finally, we can combine the results of our experiments!
